name: tinyassets
description: Work with your TinyAssets command center, inspect workflows, and manage shared knowledge from chat.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect workflows and work with your command center.
interface.longDescription: Connect your assistant to your own TinyAssets command center. Inspect workflow graphs and run status, read shared knowledge, edit workflows and pages, and send requests to your command-center agent. Writes can modify or publish data. Workflow execution and agent messages can use connected compute and external services. Requires a TinyAssets account; execution requires a configured model source and available compute.
defaultPrompt: Check my TinyAssets connection and show my workflows.
Read the notes in my TinyAssets command center.
Show the status of my latest TinyAssets workflow run.
